## A table (pandas)

```{python}
#| label: tbl-py
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics, example data."
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = sm.datasets.longley.load_pandas().data   # bundled with statsmodels, no download
tab = df[["TOTEMP", "GNP", "UNEMP"]].describe().T[["mean", "std", "min", "max"]].round(2)
from IPython.display import Markdown
Markdown(tab.to_markdown())
```

## A regression (statsmodels)

```{python}
X = sm.add_constant(df[["GNP", "UNEMP"]])
res = sm.OLS(df["TOTEMP"], X).fit(cov_type="HC1")
print(res.summary().tables[1])
```

## A figure (matplotlib)

```{python}
#| label: fig-py
#| fig-cap: "Employment against GNP, Longley data."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.scatter(df["GNP"], df["TOTEMP"], color="#0072B2")
ax.set_xlabel("GNP"); ax.set_ylabel("Total employment")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
